planning_notes: The request for 5 MEDIUM difficulty targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available 10. To ensure non-redundancy and high quality, each target utilizes a different pedagogical facet: Concept Understanding for the core VAE mechanism, Theoretical Rationale for the KL divergence component, Code Interpretation for the reparameterization trick implementation, Parameter Change for encoder architecture dimensions, and Practical Application for the Fashion-MNIST context. This spread covers theoretical, computational, and applied aspects of the lecture material.
